Based on the search results, here's what I found about Claude Code session transcript format:

## Session Storage Format

Claude Code stores a complete, machine-readable transcript of every session as structured JSONL files on your local disk. Sessions are stored in a fixed directory structure at ~/.claude/projects/ with each session as a UUID-named JSONL file under a sessions directory.

## File Structure and Contents

Each JSONL file contains a chain of typed message records linked by parentUuid: user prompts, assistant responses with content blocks (text, tool calls, thinking), tool results, system prompts, summaries, and git snapshots. The full message-by-message record includes tool calls with their exact inputs and outputs, extended thinking blocks, subagent spawning events, token usage per turn, model selection, working directory, and git state snapshots.

## Additional Metadata

Individual session files are stored as .jsonl (the complete conversation transcript), with a sessions-index.json containing auto-generated summaries, message counts, git branches, creation and modification timestamps.

## Tools for Working with Transcripts

The claude-code-transcripts tool is a command-line utility that takes session files exported from Claude Code (in JSON or JSONL format) and turns them into clean, navigable HTML transcripts that can be viewed in any modern web browser.

content.text:
Here's what I found about Claude Code session transcript format:

**Storage:** Claude Code stores session transcripts as **JSONL files** in `~/.claude/projects/<project>/sessions/`, with each session named by UUID.

**Format:** Each JSONL file contains typed message records linked by `parentUuid`, including:
- User prompts and assistant responses (text, tool calls, thinking blocks)
- Tool results with exact inputs/outputs
- Subagent spawning events
- Token usage, model selection, working directory, and git state snapshots

**Metadata:** A `sessions-index.json` file contains summaries, message counts, git branches, and timestamps.

**Tools for viewing transcripts:**
- [claude-code-transcripts](https://github.com/simonw/claude-code-transcripts) by Simon Willison — converts JSONL to readable HTML
- [claude-code-log](https://github.com/daaain/claude-code-log) — another Python CLI for HTML conversion

Sources:
- [GitHub - simonw/claude-code-transcripts](https://github.com/simonw/claude-code-transcripts)
- [A new way to extract detailed transcripts from Claude Code](https://simonw.substack.com/p/a-new-way-to-extract-detailed-transcripts)
- [Inside Claude Code: The Session File Format](https://medium.com/@databunny/inside-claude-code-the-session-file-format-and-how-to-inspect-it-b9998e66d56b)
